command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual

git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"

OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v2_20260912_0902"
test -f "$SCRIPT"; test -f "$SHADOW"; test ! -e "$OUT"

python3 "$SCRIPT" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9266 --cdp-port 9267 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v2_20260912_0902.stdout.json"

echo SCOPE=REAL_BROWSER_SHADOW_BLINK_RUNTIME_V2_NO_LIVE_WRITE
